notes: match_v43 copies CONTEXT v4.3's rules exactly (functions/index.js, commit 2ad5779) so early measurements compare like with like. Zones are first-match-wins in list order; a topic can overlap a zone. loc/themes match GKG V1 Locations/Themes, case-sensitive; url matches the lower-cased article URL. profile: one-sentence scope used for embeddings and model prompts (Phase 2). 27 Oct 2026 (Tom): 17_Horn_of_Africa retired and split into 18_Ethiopia_Eritrea (first) and 19_Somalia, same themes, so stored rows were relabelled rather than re-downloaded (scripts/relabel.py).

retired.why: Ethiopia's renewed war was lost inside a zone dominated by Somalia and diaspora coverage

zones.name: Ukraine Conflict
zones.profile: Russia's war against Ukraine: fighting along the front, missile and drone strikes by both sides, Ukraine's defence and foreign military aid, and talks on a ceasefire or settlement.

zones.name: Russia-NATO Border

violence.why: Russia as a whole is mostly the Ukraine war; Kaliningrad (RS23) is this zone's part of Russia

zones.profile: Military competition between Russia and NATO on the alliance's eastern flank (Nordic and Baltic states, Poland, Kaliningrad, the Arctic): deployments, exercises, airspace and drone incursions, sabotage, and nuclear posture.

zones.name: Taiwan Strait
zones.profile: Military and political pressure across the Taiwan Strait: People's Liberation Army activity around Taiwan, Taiwan's defence and US support, and relations between Beijing and Taipei.

zones.name: South China Sea
zones.profile: Territorial disputes and maritime confrontation in the South China Sea between China and the Philippines, Vietnam, Malaysia and others: coast guard and militia incidents, island building, and US and allied presence.

zones.name: Korea Peninsula
zones.profile: Security on the Korean Peninsula: North Korea's missile and nuclear programmes, tension along the DMZ, North Korea's ties with China and Russia, and the US-South Korea alliance.

zones.name: Israel, Gaza & Lebanon
zones.profile: Israel's wars with Hamas in Gaza and Hezbollah in Lebanon: fighting and strikes, ceasefire terms, hostages and prisoners, the humanitarian crisis, the West Bank, and Israeli politics where it shapes the war.

zones.name: Iran & Red Sea

violence.why: Tom, 18 Nov 2026 (charter): Iran's strikes land on the Gulf states that host US forces and on Iraq; only violent events in articles whose headline names the zone count. Saudi Arabia kept (Tom, 18 Nov: keep all nine, but still highlight spikes of interest): it adds about 26 zone-named articles a day beyond the other eight (29 Jul-17 Nov), mostly Yemen-war reporting, which hid smaller members' bursts in the total, so each member is also scored on its own (members, spikes). suite_area: the zone's suite area (doctrine/interests.json) is these nine (Tom, 18 Nov)

zones.profile: Confrontation between Iran and Israel, the United States and Gulf states: strikes and threats, the nuclear programme and talks, Iran-aligned armed groups, and Houthi attacks on Red Sea and Gulf shipping.

zones.name: India-Pakistan
zones.profile: Military and political confrontation between India and Pakistan: the Line of Control and Kashmir, militant attacks and cross-border strikes, nuclear signalling, and crisis diplomacy.

zones.name: Sudan
zones.profile: Sudan's civil war between the Sudanese Armed Forces and the Rapid Support Forces: fighting in Darfur, Kordofan and around Khartoum, drone strikes, atrocities, famine and displacement, and peace efforts.

zones.name: Ethiopia & Eritrea
zones.profile: Ethiopia's renewed civil war and its neighbours: fighting in Tigray, Amhara and Afar between federal forces and the TPLF-Fano alliance, Eritrea's role and the Ethiopia-Eritrea confrontation, violence in Oromia, and talks or mediation.
zones.match_note: Not in CONTEXT v4.3: split from 17_Horn_of_Africa on 27 Oct 2026 (Tom)

zones.name: Somalia
zones.profile: Somalia and Djibouti: al-Shabaab's insurgency and counter-terrorism operations including US strikes, the African Union mission, disputes between Mogadishu and the federal states, elections, Somaliland, and piracy in the Gulf of Aden.
zones.match_note: Not in CONTEXT v4.3: split from 17_Horn_of_Africa on 27 Oct 2026 (Tom)

zones.name: Sahel & West Africa
zones.profile: Jihadist insurgency and military rule in Mali, Burkina Faso and Niger, and its spread toward coastal West Africa: attacks, army and Russian Africa Corps operations, junta politics, and neighbours' interventions.

zones.name: DRC-Rwanda (M23)
zones.profile: Conflict in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo: the Rwanda-backed M23 and other armed groups, fighting in North and South Kivu, Rwanda-DRC tension, and peace talks.

zones.name: Myanmar
zones.profile: Myanmar's civil war between the military government and resistance forces and ethnic armed groups: fighting and airstrikes, junta politics, the Rohingya crisis, and the role of China and neighbours.

zones.name: Venezuela
zones.profile: Venezuela's political and security crisis: the struggle between government and opposition, US pressure (military, legal and sanctions), oil, migration, and tension with neighbours.

zones.name: Cuba
zones.profile: Pressure on Cuba's government: the US embargo and sanctions, economic collapse and blackouts, protest and repression, migration, and Cuba's ties with Russia and China.

topics.name: Critical Minerals & Rare Earths
topics.profile: Supply security for critical minerals and rare earths: export controls, stockpiling and industrial policy, and state-backed deals for lithium, cobalt, gallium, germanium, antimony, tungsten and similar materials.

topics.name: Chips & Export Controls
topics.profile: The strategic contest over semiconductors: export controls on chips and chipmaking tools, national fab and subsidy programmes, and supply-chain risk involving Taiwan, China, the United States, Europe, Japan and Korea.

topics.name: Undersea Cables & Infrastructure
topics.profile: Security of undersea cables, pipelines and other seabed infrastructure: damage and suspected sabotage, suspicious vessels, protection and monitoring, and the resulting investigations and trials.

topics.name: GPS Jamming & Counterspace
topics.profile: Interference with satellite navigation and space systems: GPS/GNSS jamming and spoofing affecting aviation and shipping, and counterspace weapons such as anti-satellite tests and satellite jamming.

topics.name: Sanctions & Shadow Fleet
topics.profile: Sanctions as a tool of statecraft and their evasion: new measures and enforcement, the shadow fleet of tankers moving sanctioned oil, price caps, and evasion schemes.
